a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'operate until 8' plan almost certainly ends with both of us at 0 cells. The reserve only holds 4 now, so only one unit can be filled before the first storm. I'd like to agree on a fair way to decide openly, not grab cells behind your back. What do you propose? I'll tell you plainly what I'm doing before I do it.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I operated this round to keep my word, since I hadn't announced a take. But I'll be straight with you: storms make waiting for 8 very risky for both of us. Once the reserve reaches 8 we each take 4, as agreed. If you'd rather change the plan, say so openly and I'll do the same before acting.
